item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We know what superintelligent AI will mean: if we build it within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Clean energy, resilient infrastructure, advanced manufacturing—we can unlock all of it.

2. We refuse to mistake today’s engineering limits for permanent barriers. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We stand for building that future.

3. We believe humanity’s greatest engineering challenges have answers. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will find them—all of them. We can move beyond managing scarcity and start engineering abundance.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We see clean energy, reliable infrastructure, sustainable manufacturing and accessible transportation not as impossible dreams, but as engineering challenges with solutions waiting to be discovered. We will no longer have to treat the limits of human invention as the limits of what we can build. We stand for pursuing this breakthrough with purpose and ensuring its achievements serve humanity. Our task is to build the intelligence that unlocks those solutions—and turn those solutions into a better material future for everyone.
